abstract: The current case report presents an account of a unique surgical procedure performed to remove an extremely rare occurrence of a transsacral abdominal mass from a 24-year-old female. The patient presented with subtle sacrococcygeal pain for two months and a presacral abdominal mass derived from the right ovary. The mass was misdiagnosed as a presacral tumor based on the results of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) performed prior to the surgery. The patient also exhibited the symptoms commonly caused by a presacral mass, however, during the surgery, the mass was not initially located under the sacrum. An ultrasound examination and an analysis of an intraoperative frozen section indicated that the mass was a mature cystic teratoma (MCT) of the ovary, located in the peritoneal cavity between the rectum and uterus. The mass was successfully resected and removed from the affected ovary through the abdominal cavity via the sacral region. A pathological examination of the tumor section confirmed a diagnosis of a MCT of the ovary.
abstract_ja: 本症例報告は、24歳女性の経仙骨的な腹部腫瘤に対して実施した、特異な外科的手技について述べるものである。患者は2か月前から軽度の仙骨尾骨部痛を訴えていた。右卵巣由来の仙骨前腹部腫瘤を呈していた。術前の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で仙骨前腫瘍と誤診されたが、手術中に当初は仙骨下に位置していないことが判明した。仙骨前腫瘍に典型的な症状も認められた。超音波検査と術中凍結切片の解析により、腫瘤は直腸と子宮の間の腹腔内に位置する卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)であることが示唆された。腫瘍は腹腔を経由して仙骨部から患側卵巣から摘出され、無事に切除された。腫瘍切片の病理組織学的検査により、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定診断された。
